parts.text:
lets make a demo app of a chat cache status

have the ability to see if a chat's cache is warm, about to expire or expired.
purpose is to show before prompting when a chat has gone cold and will require re-caching.
Built and validated [Chat Cache Status](/a/chat-cache-status), featuring live cache states, expiration countdowns, filters, pre-prompt warnings, and simulated re-caching.

enhancement.description: Live cache states with expiration countdowns, pre-prompt cold warnings, filters, and simulated re-caching.
enhancement.prompt: I want an app that shows my chat sessions and whether each cache is warm, about to expire, or expired, so I can see before I prompt which chats have gone cold and need re-caching, using my chat history and cache timestamps.
enhancement.response:
Built — Chat Cache Status, a demo app for checking whether a chat cache is warm, nearing expiry, or expired.

- Shows each chat’s current cache state with clear warm / about-to-expire / expired labeling.
- Includes an expiration countdown so you can see when a cache is getting stale.
- Surfaces pre-prompt warnings before a chat has gone cold, so you know when re-caching is needed.
- Lets you filter chats by cache status to quickly find the ones needing attention.
- Includes a simulated re-caching action to refresh a cold cache in the demo.

Use it by opening the chat list, watching the status badges and countdowns, and checking for the warning before you prompt again.
